questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental part of the cell theory?
options: All living things are made up of cells
Cells are the basic units of structure and function
New cells come from existing cells
All cells contain a membrane-bound nucleus
questions.answer: All cells contain a membrane-bound nucleus
